program.name: Calm Volume
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Three calm days: a Pilates series, slow-tempo strength for one area, then long yin holds.
program.about: A three-day rotation of calm, slow strength. Each session opens with a Pilates series, lifts slowly for the upper body, the lower body or everything, and ends with long yin holds. The tempo makes moderate weights feel heavy. Level II slows every rep down and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Upper / lower / full body: Pilates, slow strength, yin
